name: Himehara Mari
source:
A second-year student at Narahama High School.

Though academically outstanding and a proud daughter of an affluent family, there's no end to the waves of boys who take a special interest in her, due to her radiant innocence and willingness to hold a conversation with practically anyone.

Despite being beloved by all, she merely acts this out as just a role to be played, skillfully taking on the task of not being disliked by anyone. 
These expectations inwardly suffocate her mind as the days go by.
